newsitem.title: UK: ING Barings boosts Hong Kong equity derivs group.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings boosts Hong Kong equity derivs group.

text.p: ING Barings Equity Financial Products Group has hired Virginia Mumford as director and business development manager for equity derivative products in Asia, among other appointments.
A statement said Keat Foo will join from Paribas as director and head of equity derivative sales, covering Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia.

Other members of the new team, put together by Christian Kwek, who has moved to Hong Kong from London, are Felice Chen, who will market to Taiwanese institutional and corporate investors; Ching Shao, marketing to clients in Hong Kong and Anthony Deal, new manager for convertible bond sales.
Lily Choy will focus on research for convertible bonds.
